name: plugin.token_economizer
description: Experience-driven black-box cost control for coding agents with micro-skills lifecycle, dynamic tool pruning, and 3-tier failure-loop turn guard intervention
trust_justification: Pure computation, advisory-only context pruning, no filesystem/network/env access
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: te_record_micro_skill
entrypoints.description: Record an observation of a repository micro-skill fact to update its lifecycle and firing gate

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the micro-skill fact (e.g. 'pytest_cmd')

parameters.name: success
parameters.description: Whether the fact was confirmed by successful execution or contradicted by failure

parameters.name: edited_files
parameters.description: List of files touched during this task to verify drift promotion

parameters.name: is_high_stakes
parameters.description: Whether this is a high-stakes fact retired immediately on a single clean contradiction

parameters.name: assertion
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the fact assertion

entrypoints.name: te_get_active_micro_skills
entrypoints.description: Retrieve all active micro-skills that have passed confirmation and cleared the 40% firing gate

entrypoints.name: te_evaluate_tool_pruning
entrypoints.description: Evaluate loaded tool definitions against session usage history and determine which tools to prune from prompt context

parameters.name: loaded_tools
parameters.description: List of tool names currently loaded by the agent

parameters.name: session_tool_history
parameters.description: Historical session tool usage dictionaries ({tool_name: count})

parameters.name: protected_tools
parameters.description: Optional additional tools that must never be pruned

parameters.name: inapplicable_tools
parameters.description: Tools that should be pruned by construction

parameters.name: evidence_sessions_threshold
parameters.description: Number of consecutive unused sessions before pruning (default: 2)

entrypoints.name: te_evaluate_turn_guard
entrypoints.description: Evaluate ongoing turn trajectory against 3-tier failure-loop heuristics (edit churn, sustained errors, repeat stagnation, and envelope margin)

parameters.name: turn_history
parameters.description: List of step records in current turn ({tool, status, is_error, error_message, file_path})

parameters.name: envelope_turn_p90
parameters.description: The p90 turn length of resolved tasks for this repository (default: 20)

parameters.name: envelope_margin
parameters.description: Margin multiplier over resolved envelope before intervening (default: 1.25)

entrypoints.name: te_get_token_ledger
entrypoints.description: Retrieve cumulative token savings, net USD cost reduction, and intervention statistics

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: Whether to reset metrics after retrieval
